name: Microgrid dynamic-compensator reference interface
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Sends the assigned reactive or voltage target to the selected compensator control system.
description: Sends the assigned reactive or voltage target to the selected compensator control system. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Authorized compensation target” at the input and “Compensator reference” at the output. The compensator's accepted mode must be identified.

Show each measured quantity, target and resource capability limit.
